correctness.rationale: All positive integers a,b and couplings J,rho,kappa quantified; Walsh eigenvalues indexed by rectangle, each energy eigenspace contributes precisely one bright vector. Dissipativity makes its orthogonal complement the entire no-decay space. Positive rational collisions use primitive-step chains and an exact edge count. Krawtchouk character sums yield all site projections; single-weight Fourier classes force block-corner full-capture candidates; parity on each merged chain yields exactly two at resonance. Verified independently with 144 exact/direct Walsh parameter checks (8100 sites) and 168 dissipative propagations, with numerical error limits explicitly recorded in CHECKS.txt. Finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The two-block anisotropic hypercube is a natural tunable quantum transport model. The theorem supplies a complete exact list and number of all exceptional hopping ratios, all rank losses, all individual-site capture efficiencies and complete-capture parity selection for every block size. Rational resonances create a sharp quantized transport boundary not available from generic methods without new counting and site-rigidity steps. This is a motivated infinite-family classification, not an arbitrary small numerical gain.
